bathymetry.method: Coarse ETOPO1/GEBCO-derived ocean depths (about 1.8 km) far offshore; within about 3 km of the OSM coastline a modelled profile is blended in: lagoon 1-8 m deep to ~800 m offshore, reef crest at ~0.7 m, then an outer slope of 0.35 m/m. Bays inside the reef are NOT individually surveyed. Enclosed bays (sea surrounded by land on at least 11 of 16 bearings) are modelled as deep drowned valleys: 2 m + 0.12 x distance from shore, to 45 m, and carry no reef.

coastline.name: OpenStreetMap natural=coastline
coastline.note: All coastline in the area is closed island rings.

approximations: Copernicus GLO-30 is a surface model: forest canopy and buildings are included in land heights (typically +5 to +25 m in dense forest).
Land cells the DEM puts at or below sea level but OSM marks as land are raised to 0.6-1.0 m (0.458 km2).

Sea depth: Coarse ETOPO1/GEBCO-derived ocean depths (about 1.8 km) far offshore; within about 3 km of the OSM coastline a modelled profile is blended in: lagoon 1-8 m deep to ~800 m offshore, reef crest at ~0.7 m, then an outer slope of 0.35 m/m. Bays inside the reef are NOT individually surveyed. Enclosed bays (sea surrounded by land on at least 11 of 16 bearings) are modelled as deep drowned valleys: 2 m + 0.12 x distance from shore, to 45 m, and carry no reef.
The DEM was resampled bilinearly from 30 m to a 35.2 m grid.
